shots.background: Foreground: loose sand and fresh footprints. Midground: the beggar band in a loose line. Deep background: rolling ochre dunes to the horizon, a single dead tree on a far ridge, morning haze.
shots.choreography: Beat 1 (0-4s): band enters frame left, walking uphill in a loose line. Beat 2 (4-7s): Sparrow weaves between the others, laughing, Hong leads. Beat 3, payoff (7-10s): band crests the dune and pauses, looking down at the caravanserai valley below, hold on the pause.
shots.cameraChoreography: Crane: starts low at sand level, rises to 3 metres as the band crests the dune, ending in a wide framing with the band left and the valley right.
shots.lighting: Low dawn sun from frame right, warm gold on sand crests, long shadows to the left, no fill light yet.
shots.focus: Deep focus: band and distant dead tree both sharp.
shots.motion: Subject motion: steady uphill walk, sand slipping back underfoot. Background motion: wind rippling dune crests. Camera leads the band, rising with them.
shots.extras: Five to seven beggar extras in distinct patched robes, each with a distinct prop: bowl, rope, short staff, sack, flute.
shots.loreNotes: Beggar sect rule: lowest sect, survives on what others discard; no swords, only staffs, bowls, ropes. Geography rule: open dunes only, no fourth location.

departments.production-design: Dead tree on far ridge must appear in s01 and s09
departments.costume: No clean garments; Hong ankle-length robe, Sparrow knee-length robe
departments.sound: No music yet in s01; wind, footsteps, distant laughter only

shots.action: plants his staff in the sand at the caravanserai gate
shots.soundMood: staff thud in sand, cloth in wind

shots.background: Foreground: caravanserai gate threshold and broken cart wheel. Midground: courtyard with wellhead and stacked water jars. Deep background: broken arch gate with five lanterns, three lit at night, torn awning cloth moving in wind.
shots.choreography: Beat 1 (0-3s): Hong walks to the gate threshold. Beat 2 (3-7s): Hong plants his staff in the sand with both hands. Beat 3, payoff (7-10s): Hong stands still, staff grounded, looking toward the horizon, hold on the claim staked.
shots.cameraChoreography: Tracking: camera moves with Hong from 5 metres to 2 metres, ending in a wide shot with the arch behind him and the staff centred.
shots.lighting: Dusk light, blood-red low sun behind the arch, warm lantern light beginning on the courtyard, long shadows.
shots.focus: Focus on Hong and staff, arch slightly soft behind him.
shots.motion: Subject motion: single deliberate walk and plant, then stillness. Background motion: awning cloth and lantern sway in wind. Camera follows, then stops with him.
shots.extras: Two beggar extras unloading a sack by the wellhead, not looking at Hong.
shots.loreNotes: Staff rule: the staff is passed, not inherited, and is the chief's symbol of authority. Planting it stakes a claim on the caravanserai.

departments.production-design: Broken arch: top-left voussoir missing, same in every caravanserai shot
departments.costume: Hong rope belt with three knots, wine gourd on a cord
departments.sound: Staff thud single and dry, then two seconds of silence

shots.action: watches the sandstorm on the horizon, smile fading

shots.background: Foreground: caravanserai roof tiles and a loose tile edge. Midground: Sparrow standing on the roofline. Deep background: a sandstorm wall on the horizon, darkening the sky from the east.
shots.choreography: Beat 1 (0-3s): Sparrow steps to the roof edge, hand shading her eyes. Beat 2 (3-7s): She watches the storm wall approach, smile fading. Beat 3, payoff (7-10s): She turns back toward the courtyard and calls out, hold on her turned face.
shots.cameraChoreography: Push-in: from a medium shot at 4 metres to a closer framing at 2 metres, ending on Sparrow's face with the storm wall behind her.
shots.lighting: Dusk light failing, storm wall darkening the sky, last warm light on Sparrow's face from the west.
shots.focus: Rack focus from Sparrow to the storm wall in beat 2, back to Sparrow in beat 3.
shots.motion: Subject motion: step, watch, turn — three clear moves. Background motion: storm wall advancing slowly, dust rising. Camera pushes in steadily.
shots.extras: No extras on the roof; one beggar extra in the courtyard below, looking up.
shots.loreNotes: Sparrow rule: she is scout and messenger, which is why she is on the roof. Storm rule: the storm uncovers the tombs; it is cause, not atmosphere.

departments.production-design: Roofline is the same caravanserai roof as s02's courtyard
departments.costume: Sparrow straw sandals, right strap broken, visible in this shot
departments.sound: No music; wind rising, sand hissing, Sparrow's breath
